scan_only_reference.description: planning reference only; not a required revenue mix

daily_execution.rule: execute every day; if a qualified executable action exists, do not end at recommendation

conditional_minimums.linkedin_company: 1 unique commercial post when qualified unique evidence exists
conditional_minimums.instagram: 1 Mira-only business publication when a valid unique asset and provider capability exist
conditional_minimums.email: execute all due eligible warm/consented messages up to the canonical runtime limit
conditional_minimums.followup: 100% of due eligible non-suppressed follow-ups receive an action or an evidence-backed wait state
conditional_minimums.seo_content: at least one order-path action when current evidence identifies a safe high-confidence opportunity

outbound_policy.unsolicited_prospecting: identify, research, score and prepare; autonomous send is allowed only when a separately approved lawful/consent-based workflow makes the recipient eligible
outbound_policy.linkedin_dm: only when verified provider capability and recipient/context gates permit it; otherwise use the canonical supported fallback

content_identity.linkedin_personal: personal-life-only; never use as company campaign inventory
content_identity.duplicate_policy: global exact + semantic + example/theme dedupe before publication

behind_pace: increase conversion experiments within reversible limits

terminal_definition: A commercial run is terminal only after execution/readback or an evidence-backed wait/suppression decision, then outcome measurement and learning writeback.
